sql:
SELECT
  fct_posting.title,
  fct_posting.url
FROM fct_posting
JOIN dim_company
  ON fct_posting.company_key = dim_company.company_key
WHERE
  fct_posting.is_open = TRUE AND fct_posting.remote_us = TRUE AND fct_posting.family = 'ai_engineer' AND dim_company.company_name = 'Reddit'
